hits.title: Paramount agrees to pause Warner Bros deal while court case plays out
hits.snippet: Paramount Skydance has agreed to pause its $110bn acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery until after a federal judge rules on states’ challenge to the deal, according to court papers.
